gemini_api_video_understanding.browser_vs_video_distinction_note: Web page navigation in a browser merely retrieves HTML/DOM metadata and thumbnail assets; it does not constitute multimodal video stream understanding. Consistent with project rules, opening the page was not treated as successful video analysis.

No high-FPS decoded frame sequence exists in the repository workspace.

data_sources_used: Public video metadata (video title, chapters, duration)

observed_facts: The video duration is 1203.9 seconds across 7 major chapters (Prologue + Chapters 1-5 + Epilogue).
Visual style uses a dark/black background (#0a0a0c - #121212) with minimal, high-contrast white text (#ffffff) and selective accent colors (blue, red, gold/yellow).
Graphic elements are simplified pictograms (human silhouettes), bar charts (coin piles/height representations), and spotlights.
Subtitles are positioned bottom-center, white text in 1-2 lines without heavy background boxes.
The prologue begins with a historical/social question ('Why can't we be second?' - 2009 government restructuring statement).
inferred_hypotheses: Sub-second animation timing curves, exact bezier control points, and easing durations (estimated based on typical documentary-style motion design standards).
Specific pixel-level transforms and spring constants.
Audio sync points and voiceover waveforms (audio was unverified/muted in prior observations).

1_overall_structure.summary: Documentary-essay structure breaking down a complex economic concept into progressive inquiry chapters.

chapters.content: Posing the initial dilemma using real-world public statement ('Why can't we be second?'). Establishing the theme of winner-take-all dynamics.

chapters.title: 0.005秒の段差
chapters.content: Sports competition (sprint times, podium) illustrating huge reward differences from minute skill gaps.

chapters.title: 二番目に高い山の憂鬱
chapters.content: Human silhouettes, highlighting a single winner with spotlights, tennis court comparisons, and bar charts.
Theoretical breakdown of superstar economics and market scalability.
Technological reproduction and globalization magnifying winner advantages.
Implications for individuals and survival strategies in skewed markets.

2_scene_transitions.style: Minimalist and non-distracting cuts, fades, and dark-outs.
2_scene_transitions.details: Scenes transition primarily through subtle fades to/from pure dark backgrounds, cross-dissolves, or spotlight-driven focus shifts. Elaborate geometric wipes, 3D rotations, or flashy sliding transitions are strictly avoided to maintain a serious, thoughtful tone.

primary_animations.description: Gradual emergence and dissipation of text headlines, subtitles, and vector shapes.
Subtle upward drift accompanying fades (approx. 20-40px rise) when text or icons appear, creating a grounded reveal effect.
Vertical bar charts growing upward from a base anchor to visually demonstrate numerical gaps and distributions.
Dimming surrounding elements while illuminating a specific target object to guide viewer attention.

4_object_appearance_and_disappearance.appearance_principles: Objects do not pop in abruptly. They enter sequentially: first the context/spotlight, followed by the core headline, then the accompanying illustration (pictogram/diagram).
4_object_appearance_and_disappearance.disappearance_principles: Objects fade out cleanly before the next concept enters, preventing visual clutter.

5_motion_direction_and_timing.direction: Predominantly bottom-to-top (Y-axis negative) reveals for text and charts, reinforcing stability and growth.
5_motion_direction_and_timing.timing_and_easing: Smooth deceleration (Ease-Out / cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1)). Quick initial motion with an extended settling phase so text is easily readable upon arrival.

layout_composition.grid: Central alignment for core questions; split 50/50 comparison for contrasting states (1st vs 2nd place).
layout_composition.margins_and_breathing_room: Generous negative space (at least 200px margins from edges) ensuring high focus on solitary elements.

typography.font_family: Heavy Japanese Gothic (e.g. Noto Sans JP, Hiragino Kaku Gothic StdN, Shin Go equivalent)
typography.weights: Heavy/Black (800-900) for question headlines; Bold (700) for sub-headers; Medium (500) for captions

7_directorial_intent.aesthetic_tone: Intellectual, sober, documentary-grade motion graphics designed to induce contemplation rather than excitement.
7_directorial_intent.cognitive_load_management: Only one core concept is presented per screen. Abstract mathematical and economic phenomena (power laws, winner-take-all) are translated into tangible geometric metaphors (height differences, isolated figures).

rules_for_faithful_reproduction: Rule 1: Eliminate unnecessary decor (no particle effects, no bouncy cartoon springs, no excessive drop shadows).
Rule 2: Anchor animations to Ease-Out curves with long settling times for maximum legibility.
Rule 3: Maintain strict high-contrast ratio (>= 4.5:1, typically > 10:1) with a deep dark canvas.
Rule 4: Ensure visual elements appear in synchronized semantic progression (Question text -> Accent underscore -> Illustrative pictogram).
Rule 5: Subtitles must remain understated at bottom-center without obstructing central visual metaphors.

selected_analysis_segment.rationale: Represents the most iconic, fundamental motion pattern in the reference video: a solitary question emerging in darkness, accented and underscored by a focal point.
